projects.titleHr: Međunarodne bolnice, sportska medicina i rehabilitacija
projects.titleEn: International hospitals, sports medicine and rehabilitation
projects.objectiveHr: Razvoj međunarodnog zdravstvenog i rehabilitacijskog sustava povezanog sa sportom, dijagnostikom i oporavkom.
projects.objectiveEn: Development of an international healthcare and rehabilitation system connected with sport, diagnostics and recovery.

projects.titleHr: Sportski sustavi, performance tracking i sportska oprema
projects.titleEn: Sports systems, performance tracking and sports equipment
projects.objectiveHr: Tehnologije i operativni sustavi za praćenje učinka, sportske podatke i specijaliziranu opremu.
projects.objectiveEn: Technology and operating systems for performance tracking, sports data and specialised equipment.

projects.titleHr: Bankarski, payment i digital exchange softver
projects.titleEn: Banking, payment and digital exchange software
projects.objectiveHr: Specijalizirane platforme za obradu transakcija, plaćanja, digital exchange i integraciju financijskih procesa.
projects.objectiveEn: Specialised platforms for transaction processing, payments, digital exchange and financial-process integration.

projects.titleHr: Stablecoin i digitalni instrument povezan sa zlatom
projects.objectiveHr: Koncept digitalnog instrumenta uz strogo odvajanje tehničkog razvoja, pravne kvalifikacije i buduće tržišne primjene.
projects.objectiveEn: A digital-instrument concept with strict separation of technical development, legal qualification and future market use.

projects.titleHr: Međunarodno sveučilište u SAD-u i još tri države
projects.titleEn: International university in the United States and three additional countries
projects.objectiveHr: Razvoj međunarodnog obrazovnog sustava s tehnološkim, poslovnim, sportskim i istraživačkim programima.
projects.objectiveEn: Development of an international education system covering technology, business, sport and research programmes.

projects.titleHr: Organska proteinska hrana i jestiva ulja
projects.titleEn: Organic protein food and edible oils
projects.objectiveHr: Vertikalno povezan prehrambeni program s fokusom na kvalitetu, sljedivost, održivost i međunarodnu distribuciju.
projects.objectiveEn: A vertically connected food programme focused on quality, traceability, sustainability and international distribution.

projects.objectiveHr: Industrijski kapaciteti za odabrane proizvode i tehnologije unutar buduće grupne mreže.
projects.objectiveEn: Industrial capacity for selected products and technologies within the future Group network.

projects.titleEn: Oil, refined products and energy trading
projects.objectiveHr: Razvoj kontroliranog energetskog trgovačkog i logističkog modela uz pojačanu pravnu i financijsku provjeru.
projects.objectiveEn: Development of a controlled energy-trading and logistics model with enhanced legal and financial review.

projects.titleHr: THE CODE — akvizicija i povezivanje više međunarodnih kompanija
projects.titleEn: THE CODE — acquisition and integration of multiple international companies
projects.objectiveHr: Međunarodna akvizicija i integracijska arhitektura kojom se 7. listopada 2026. u New Yorku predstavljaju tri povjerljiva globalna društva.
projects.objectiveEn: An international acquisition and integration architecture under which three confidential global companies are presented in New York on 7 October 2026.
